dialogues.jp:
自室のベッドにねそべりながらぼーっと漫画雑
誌を眺める。
dialogues.en: I was lying on my bed, reading a comic book.
dialogues.text: I was lying on my bed, reading a comic book.

dialogues.jp:
とは言っても、内容などろくに頭に入ってはい
ない。
dialogues.en:
Although not a single thing I was reading was processed in
my brain.
dialogues.text:
Although not a single thing I was reading was processed in
my brain.

dialogues.jp:
大ゴマで見得を切る主人公のアップは、もう二
十分近くそのままだった。
dialogues.en: It's been 20 minutes since I've even turned the page.
dialogues.text: It's been 20 minutes since I've even turned the page.

dialogues.jp: なんで……？
dialogues.en: Why...?
dialogues.text: Why...?

dialogues.jp: 頭の中は消えることのない疑問符。
dialogues.en: That question mark would not go away from within my head.
dialogues.text: That question mark would not go away from within my head.

dialogues.jp:
そして同じシーンばかりが繰り返し、繰り返し
再生されていた。
dialogues.en:
And that same scene came replaying over and over again
inside it.
dialogues.text:
And that same scene came replaying over and over again
inside it.

dialogues.jp:
『………………実を言えば俺が好きなのは……
　朝倉、お前だよ』
dialogues.en: "....The one I said that I liked... it's you, Asakura."
dialogues.text: "....The one I said that I liked... it's you, Asakura."

dialogues.jp:
照れくさそうに、それでも微笑みながらそう告
げた工藤の顔。
dialogues.en:
His face was blushing slightly as he said that, with a
smile.
dialogues.text:
His face was blushing slightly as he said that, with a
smile.

dialogues.jp: 「……本当にどうしたんだ俺」
dialogues.en: "...What on earth is happening to me?"
dialogues.text: "...What on earth is happening to me?"

dialogues.jp:
本来はこの直後に『マジ信じか？』とからかう
シーンが来る筈なのだが――。
dialogues.en:
When the actual thing happened, it was immediately followed
by "You really believed me?"...
dialogues.text:
When the actual thing happened, it was immediately followed
by "You really believed me?"...

dialogues.jp:
繰り返されるシーンは、まるでその続きが存在
しなかったかのように、またそこで初めに戻っ
てしまう。
dialogues.en:
But in my head, the scene kept on going back to the
beginning before it can reach that point.
dialogues.text:
But in my head, the scene kept on going back to the
beginning before it can reach that point.

dialogues.jp: 『朝倉、お前だよ』
dialogues.en: "It's you, Asakura."
dialogues.text: "It's you, Asakura."

dialogues.jp: 『お前だよ』
dialogues.en: "It's you."
dialogues.text: "It's you."

dialogues.jp: 「なんなんだよ……」
dialogues.en: "What's going on..."
dialogues.text: "What's going on..."

dialogues.jp:
とうとう漫画雑誌を読むことをあきらめた俺は、
ごろりと横になった。
dialogues.en:
I gave up the pretense of reading the comic book, and shut
it tightly.
dialogues.text:
I gave up the pretense of reading the comic book, and shut
it tightly.

dialogues.jp: 大きなため息をはいて目を閉じる。
dialogues.en: With a big sigh, I closed my eyes.
dialogues.text: With a big sigh, I closed my eyes.

dialogues.jp:
三秒数えてゆっくり開けると、クリーム色の天
井が見えた。
dialogues.en:
Three seconds later, my eyes opened again to the sight of
the cream-coloured ceiling.
dialogues.text:
Three seconds later, my eyes opened again to the sight of
the cream-coloured ceiling.

dialogues.jp: 「あんなの、ただの冗談じゃないか」
dialogues.en: "That was nothing more than a joke."
dialogues.text: "That was nothing more than a joke."

dialogues.jp: わかった、冷静になろうぜ。
dialogues.en: That's right, that's why I should calm down.
dialogues.text: That's right, that's why I should calm down.

dialogues.jp:
工藤のせいじゃない。あんなのを本気にする、
今日の俺がどうかしてるのだ。
dialogues.en:
It's not Kudou's fault. Even if he was serious, I shouldn't
be acting like this.
dialogues.text:
It's not Kudou's fault. Even if he was serious, I shouldn't
be acting like this.

dialogues.jp: そうさ、そりゃ、工藤はいい友達だ。好きだよ。
dialogues.en: Yeah, he's a good friend after all. I like him.
dialogues.text: Yeah, he's a good friend after all. I like him.

dialogues.jp:
でもそれは、あくまで友達としての、「好き」
だった筈で、
dialogues.en: That is, I like him as a friend.
dialogues.text: That is, I like him as a friend.

dialogues.jp: こんな、今みたいな気持ちはありえない。
dialogues.en: These feelings right now are unbelievable.
dialogues.text: These feelings right now are unbelievable.

dialogues.jp: ありえない筈だ。
dialogues.en: Definitely unbelievable.
dialogues.text: Definitely unbelievable.

dialogues.jp:
でも、気が付くと工藤の姿を思い浮かべている
自分がいる。
dialogues.en: But, always thinking of him the way I am now...
dialogues.text: But, always thinking of him the way I am now...

dialogues.jp: こんなのまるで……。
dialogues.en: Wouldn't this be...
dialogues.text: Wouldn't this be...

dialogues.jp: 「恋みたいじゃねーか」
dialogues.en: "...Love?"
dialogues.text: "...Love?"

dialogues.jp:
自然と口からこぼれた一言に、何故か俺の胸が
きゅっと痛む。
dialogues.en: As that word left my mouth, my chest tightened up suddenly.
dialogues.text: As that word left my mouth, my chest tightened up suddenly.

dialogues.jp: 「……かったる」
dialogues.en: "...Troublesome..."
dialogues.text: "...Troublesome..."

dialogues.jp:
余計な思考を｛しゃだん／遮断｝するように、部屋の明かりを
消すと、俺は再び目を閉じ、意識を放棄した。
dialogues.en:
Abandoning my thoughts before they got any further, I
switched off the bedside lamp, and closed my eyes, forcing
myself to sleep.
dialogues.text:
Abandoning my thoughts before they got any further, I
switched off the bedside lamp, and closed my eyes, forcing
myself to sleep.

dialogues.jp: ◆コイゴコロ注意報◆
dialogues.en: ◆Warning: Love Approaching◆
dialogues.text: ◆Warning: Love Approaching◆

dialogues.jp:
俺に対する工藤のからかいだったとは言え、
工藤からの告白が頭から離れない。
dialogues.en:
Kudou's confession when I confronted him would not leave my
head.
dialogues.text:
Kudou's confession when I confronted him would not leave my
head.

dialogues.jp: どうしたんだ俺……。
dialogues.en: What on earth is happening to me...
dialogues.text: What on earth is happening to me...
